svg.aria-label: A warp sum by shuffles, drawn on 8 lanes. The registers start as 2, 6, 3, 4, 5, 1, 8, 3. With distance 4, lanes 0 to 3 add the values of lanes 4 to 7: 7, 7, 11, 7. With distance 2: 18, 14. With distance 1: lane 0 holds 32. The same numbers as the tree in shared memory, with no shared memory and no barrier.
svg.text: The same additions as the tree, in registers.

g.text: the register value of lanes 0 to 7 (no shared memory, no barrier)
Each lane adds the value of the lane distance places to its right. A real warp has 32 lanes
and 5 steps, with distances 16, 8, 4, 2 and 1. Gray lanes hold values we do not use.
